journey.name: Trip Price Calculation - Heavy Traffic
journey.description: Verifies trip price calculation under heavy traffic conditions by selecting the 'Heavy Traffic (+10%)' option for a 10 km, 20 minute trip. Validates that the estimated price calculates to 113 EGP.

actions.action: Tap "Start" on the home screen to open the distance entry screen.
Clear the text field, type "10" into the text field labeled "Distance in kilometers", and tap "Next".
Clear the text field, type "20" into the text field labeled "Time in minutes", and tap "Next".
Tap the "Heavy Traffic (+10%)" radio button option to select heavy traffic, then tap "Calculate Trip Price".
Verify that the estimated trip price screen displays "113" and the "Price Calculated Successfully!" message.
